name: Cultural Landscape of Kenozero Lake
description: Around Lake Kenozero, in Russia's far north-west within Arkhangelsk Oblast, villages of weathered log houses and wooden chapels sit among forests, fields and water. People have farmed here since the 12th century, blending Slavic and Finno-Ugric traditions. Look inside the churches for the painted ceilings called "heavens". The region largely avoided Soviet-era modernization, though many villages are slowly emptying.
